title: Finding Your Career Path with Confidence
excerpt: Practical steps to align your strengths, interests, and opportunities when choosing a career direction.
author: Sarika Aggarwal

children.text: Choosing a career path is one of the most meaningful decisions you will make.
At DreamBridge, we combine psychometric science with personalized mentoring to help you discover where your talents and passions converge.
Start with self-reflection, validate through assessments, and seek guidance from mentors who understand today's job market.

title: The Art of Career Decision Making
excerpt: Learn systematic approaches to making career decisions that align with both your heart and practical reality.
author: Sarika Aggarwal

children.text: Career decisions should balance passion, aptitude, and market reality.
Use structured frameworks: list options, evaluate against your strengths, and test assumptions through conversations and short-term exposure.

title: Understanding Your True Potential
excerpt: Psychometric insights and self-discovery techniques to uncover abilities you never knew you had.
author: Sarika Aggarwal

children.text: Psychometric assessments reveal patterns in your interests, personality, and abilities that may not be obvious from everyday experience.
Combined with expert interpretation, these insights become a practical roadmap for stream selection, college planning, and career transitions.
